notes.title: Calling All Scallywags
notes.notes:
Ahoy, Pirates!

Calling all seafarers to embark on an epic quest! 🏴‍☠️ 

We’re challenging you to capture the essence of the Pirate Queen in your own unique way. Our judging panel are looking for your most striking, interesting, beautiful in-game screenshots to feature across our socials, newsletter, website and more! 🌟

And if you choose to partake, you might just lay your hands on some treasure, including a rare Pirate Queen poster signed by THE Lucy Liu herself and our wonderful director, Eloise Singer, PLUS a $20 Steam/Meta Quest voucher*. 🏆

Here's how to join the adventure:

📸 Share an in-game screenshot or bespoke artwork of our game, The Pirate Queen 🏴‍☠️👑
🏷️ Tag @thepiratequeenvr on Instagram.
🔍 Make sure you're following @thepiratequeenvr and @singerstudiosuk.

We can't wait to see what you come up with!

For full details, check out the terms and conditions on our website
https://www.singerstudios.co.uk/termsandconditions

The competition sets sail now and ends on 1st May 2024. 

To all who dare to take up the challenge - may fortune be in your favour!

notes.title: A Pirate Queen Patch
notes.notes:
Hey Pirates!

We wanted to start off by saying thank you so much to everyone who has played our game The Pirate Queen: A Forgotten Legend. We’re so happy that people are enjoying the experience and stepping into the shoes of the legendary Cheng Shih. 

We’d like to let you know that we’ve taken in all of the feedback we’ve received and are incredibly grateful for you taking the time to share your thoughts! Based on your feedback, we have updated The Pirate Queen: A Forgotten Legend.


[b]**Spoilers Below**[/b]

Known Issues
Some players may wish to reach down for items lower down. We’re working on Distance Grab to ensure players have more flexibility with objects at different heights.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Locomotion sensitivity on specific controllers
[*] Cog puzzle interaction in the Sampan Maze
[*] Fishing bait interaction on the Balcony
[*] Chopping board interaction in the kitchen
[*] Objects disappearing in inventory
[*] Korean & Japanese subtitles fixed 
[*] Respawned item behaviour 
[*] Traversing water on foot 
[/list]

[b]Polish[/b] 
[list]
[*] Visual prompts for when player's head is out-of-bounds
[*] Smooth movement that allows faster turns and better movement 
[*] Increased texture resolution on many assets across the game.
[*] Improved water materials to have higher resolution and more realistic shading.
[*] Reduced distance culling across all levels and increased LoD transition distances on many assets. (These changes should greatly reduce objects "popping" in or out during gameplay.)
[*] Improved lighting in many levels - adjusted brightness for visibility in some gameplay areas and fixed some shading errors.
[*] Fixed material shading errors on some two sided materials.
[*] Object collisions to ensure smoother interactions
[*] VO clash on areas with high volume of audio
[/list]


Thank you for reading about our update, and we’re excited for you to dive into the game and explore the high seas of 19th century China!

If you encounter any issues with the game, please join our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/TvSe2vxsGP]here[/url] and leave us feedback in our #Game-Feedback channel. We want to ensure we’re developing the best experience possible and so we’re here to help! 

If you do have any issues post-update, please contact us on Discord so we can fix this for you - it’s super helpful rather than leaving a negative review. 

We’re a small, independent developer so we really appreciate the constructive feedback and ask that players to be patient as we work behind the scenes on further updates. We’re a small team and we’ll endeavour to get back to you as soon as we can! 

Thank you so much for your support, we hope you enjoy the game! 

Singer Studios
